user.title: Connection
user.description: How is the boiler connected to Home Assistant?

menu_option_descriptions.modbus: Reads and writes locally via a Modbus TCP gateway, independent of the internet.
menu_option_descriptions.cloud: Uses the Fröling Connect account. Changing settings needs 'Fernschalten über connect möglich'.
menu_option_descriptions.hybrid: Modbus for every value it has; Fröling Connect adds the rest (operating modes, schedules, system information).

modbus.title: Modbus TCP gateway
modbus.description: The boiler (Lambdatronic 3200, COM2) is connected via a Modbus TCP gateway. 'MODBUS-Protokoll 2014' must be enabled at the boiler.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Modbus TCP gateway.

data_description.port: TCP port of the gateway, usually 502.
data_description.slave: Modbus address set at the boiler (service menu, usually 2).

cloud.title: Fröling Connect
cloud.description: Log in with your Fröling Connect account.

data_description.username: Email address of the Fröling Connect account.
data_description.password: Password of the Fröling Connect account.

data_description.facility_id: Facility of the Fröling Connect account that belongs to this boiler.

mismatch.title: Different components
mismatch.description: Modbus and Fröling Connect do not report the same components: {components}. All components found are set up; disable unwanted devices in Home Assistant.

menu_options.reconfigure_modbus: Change or add the Modbus connection
menu_options.reconfigure_cloud: Add Fröling Connect or change the login

reconfigure_modbus.title: Modbus TCP gateway
reconfigure_modbus.description: The boiler (Lambdatronic 3200, COM2) is connected via a Modbus TCP gateway. 'MODBUS-Protokoll 2014' must be enabled at the boiler.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Modbus TCP gateway.

data_description.port: TCP port of the gateway, usually 502.
data_description.slave: Modbus address set at the boiler (service menu, usually 2).

reconfigure_cloud.title: Fröling Connect
reconfigure_cloud.description: Log in with your Fröling Connect account.

data_description.username: Email address of the Fröling Connect account.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password (same account).

remove_cloud.title: Remove Fröling Connect
remove_cloud.description: The integration then uses Modbus only. Values that only Fröling Connect provides disappear.

remove_modbus.title: Remove Modbus
remove_modbus.description: The integration then uses Fröling Connect only. Values that only Modbus provides disappear.

reauth_confirm.title: Fröling Connect login
reauth_confirm.description: Fröling Connect rejected the stored login. Enter the current credentials.

data_description.username: Email address of the Fröling Connect account.
data_description.password: Password of the Fröling Connect account.

error.no_response: The gateway is reachable but the boiler does not answer. Check slave ID, cabling and the Modbus settings at the boiler.
error.invalid_slave: The boiler answered unexpectedly. Check the slave ID.
error.no_facilities: No facility found in this Fröling Connect account.
error.facility_missing: The facility of this entry is not part of this Fröling Connect account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the current values are read via Modbus (10-300 s).
data_description.parameter_interval: How often the settings are read via Modbus (1-60 min). They are also read after every change.
data_description.cloud_interval: How often Fröling Connect is read (1-60 min). Short intervals may hit the rate limit of Fröling Connect.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the boiler at {host}: {error}

value_out_of_range.message: {value} is outside the allowed range {minimum} to {maximum}.

protocol_disabled.message: The boiler refuses writes: 'MODBUS-Protokoll 2014' is disabled.

remote_control_disabled.message: Remote control via Fröling Connect is disabled.

not_writable.message: {key} cannot be written with this connection.

entity_unavailable.message: {entities} is not available at the moment.

schedule_requires_connect.message: Schedules can only be read and written with Fröling Connect.

schedule_no_days.message: Give at least one day to write.

schedule_unreadable_days.message: The phases of {days} could not be read from Fröling Connect. Give these days as well, otherwise writing the schedule would erase them.

no_schedule.message: Fröling Connect has no weekly schedule for {component}.

protocol_2014_disabled.title: {name}: Modbus writing disabled
protocol_2014_disabled.description: The boiler answers writes with 'Illegal Function'. At the boiler, open service menu (code -7) → MODBUS settings and set 'MODBUS-Protokoll 2014 verwenden' to JA. Settings can only be changed afterwards.

remote_control_disabled.title: {name}: remote control via Fröling Connect disabled
remote_control_disabled.description: Settings cannot be changed via Fröling Connect from Home Assistant; the affected entities are unavailable. Enable 'Fernschalten über connect möglich' at the boiler (Connect settings) or in the Fröling Connect app. This message disappears automatically afterwards.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Reads the weekly switch-on phases of heating circuits or hot water tanks from Fröling Connect. Days whose phases could not be read are listed in 'unreadable_days'; give them again when writing the schedule.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes the weekly switch-on phases of heating circuits or hot water tanks via Fröling Connect. Days not given stay unchanged; days whose phases could not be read must be given.

monday.name: Monday
monday.description: Switch-on phases on Monday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.

tuesday.name: Tuesday
tuesday.description: Switch-on phases on Tuesday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.

wednesday.name: Wednesday
wednesday.description: Switch-on phases on Wednesday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.

thursday.name: Thursday
thursday.description: Switch-on phases on Thursday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.

friday.name: Friday
friday.description: Switch-on phases on Friday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.

saturday.name: Saturday
saturday.description: Switch-on phases on Saturday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.

sunday.name: Sunday
sunday.description: Switch-on phases on Sunday (up to four, 'to' may be 24:00). Leave out to keep the day, give an empty list to clear it.
